newsitem.title: USA: Tiger Woods signs endorsement deal with Tudor watches.
newsitem.headline: Tiger Woods signs endorsement deal with Tudor watches.

text.p: Golf sensation Tiger Woods has signed a contract with Rolex Watch U.S.A. Inc. to endorse a new line of watches being introduced by its Tudor Watch brand, Rolex said Tuesday.

Rolex is the latest prestige name to enter into an endorsement agreement with Woods, the youngest ever Master's champion. Terms were not disclosed, but a statement from Rolex said Woods would appear in television and print ads for Tudor slated to begin in July.

"Tiger Woods is the perfect spokesman for the Tudor collection of timepieces," said Jean-Noel Bioul, executive vice president, sales and marketing, Rolex Watch U.S.A. "He wants to be associated with products that represent excellence and express his individuality."

Woods, who finished in a tie for fourth in last weekend's Colonial tournament in Fort Worth, Texas, also has endorsement deals with Nike Inc., Titleist golf products, Planet Hollywood's All Star Cafe and American Express.
When the American Express endorsement was announced May 19, Woods said he has established a "brand plan" and wanted to be sure his image is handled properly.

Bioul said a specially designed, leather-strapped Tudor Chronograph with Woods' name on the dials would be sold starting next month. Woods was presented with a Tudor watch in January and has worn it ever since, Rolex said.
